- Model consistently overestimates early in the forecast horizon, especially in the first 5–10 days, then underestimates later.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., 90+), model tends to overshoot and then fail to correct downward — overreacts to volatility.
- Model shows persistent downward bias in the latter half of the 30-day forecast, particularly after mid-range prices (85–88).
- Mean reversion is under-predicted — model fails to anticipate sharp reversals toward lower levels after peaks.
- Forecast lags the true price movement by 1–3 days, especially in downward trends — model is slow to adjust to new information.
- Model overweights recent high prices in the 30-day window, leading to overestimation of future highs — fails to account for momentum decay.
